outputs.explanation: Panel A includes bar graphs quantifying band intensity (mean ± SD, N=4) for nuclear, cytosolic, and mitochondrial fractions, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B consists of immunoelectron micrographs only, with no averaged/quantitative plot requiring individual data points.
Panel C is a western blot showing lanes from different purification methods; there is no plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a western blot showing proteinase K protection assay results; there is no plot of averaged data.
